title: ArcCivs research expansion and supported infrastructure: prospective economic assessment
assumptions: All figures are scenarios and not measured per-city throughput. The four existing research IDs, costs, durations and accepted v1/v2 terms remain unchanged.

Twelve proposed new one-time research projects have tier durations 30, 60 and 120 observed work sessions of 60 seconds per branch. Four branches require 840 nominal active minutes; old four add 21 minutes. Sleep, hunger, travel, staffing, funding and inactive chunks extend the time.

New project materials are debited once via existing inventory receipts. New Auto project demand must not trigger its own automatic material grant; ordinary courier supply remains. Existing Auto grants for construction, food and other workloads remain and may indirectly supply shared stocks; historical item provenance is not tracked.

Physical total one-time new project item consumption per city is listed separately by material; item value is not converted into currency. Legacy closed stock uses its existing nativeCost mapping and must retain exact accepted cost through migration.

At most one new tier per branch is effective; effects do not stack. Builder credits 64 to 80/96/128 rows per observed session; native placement caps and per-block material debit stay unchanged. Smeltery intervals 60 to 54/48/42 seconds give ideal exclusive-recipe throughput multipliers 1.111111/1.25/1.428571 before travel, staffing, inputs and capacity.

Meal bonuses alter hunger restored or regeneration threshold, potentially reducing future bread use; amounts are not coins. Watch radii 32 to 40/48/64 affect route choice and may alter exposure, resident losses and mob loot; realized change is unknown.

For 1/10/16 cities, assume 0.25/1/4 active hours per city-day as illustrative low/base/high. In the ideal fully staffed and continuously supplied Smeltery, cycles per city-day before are 15/60/240 and at tier III about 21.43/85.71/342.86. Recipes are alternatives, not additive; their exact input and output remain unchanged.

Current EconomyShopGUI SELL and AutoSellChests remain current observed alternatives; the owner plans SELL removal and a contracts transition. Neither route is assumed to monetize every item, and no item-to-Vault exchange rate is invented.

External rewards, player XP, premium tokens and direct Vault payments do not change. Expanded item throughput and reduced consumption may indirectly affect current sales or future contracts; adoption, demand and conversion are unknown.

Standing individual projects retain saved project id, original price, required work, funding, progress and pause; v1/v2 remain valid and legacy v3 migrates to validated v4 with the existing native mapping. Retries must not debit twice.

Water foundation cells and open gate leaves are normal paid construction items. Direct block/item quantities and any existing Auto demand top-ups may change with terrain and route; no free foundation or new grant path is introduced.

live_ledger_reference.coverage_note: Network-shared server-player shards; classifications have substantial unknown callers and totals do not establish new research throughput or ordinary-player income.

conclusion: Keep old accepted and future four base terms, add real receipt-funded optional branches with bounded effects, and measure actual item flows and player-facing results after activation; unknown indirect monetary effects are not claimed zero.
